name: Small/Medium Marketing Team
description: A marketing department template for small to medium companies (up to 500 employees). This template covers a 3-10 FTE marketing department with a Marketing Manager, Content Specialist, Digital Marketing Specialist, Designer/Creator, and a General Purpose Operator (GPO). It provides end-to-end marketing capabilities including content creation, social media management, SEO/SEM, email campaigns, brand management, and lead generation. Designed for agile marketing teams that need to move fast across multiple channels while maintaining brand consistency and measurable ROI.

metadata.industry: Technology, E-commerce, Consumer Goods, Professional Services

agents.name: Marketing Manager
agents.description: Strategic leader responsible for marketing planning, campaign oversight, budget management, cross-functional alignment, and performance reporting. Sets marketing priorities and ensures alignment with revenue goals.

agents.name: Content Specialist
agents.description: Content creation and management specialist responsible for blog posts, whitepapers, case studies, email copy, web copy, and content calendar management. Ensures brand voice consistency and SEO optimization.

agents.name: Digital Marketing Specialist
agents.description: Digital channel specialist managing paid campaigns (SEM, social ads), SEO strategy, email marketing automation, analytics, and lead nurturing workflows. Focused on measurable results and conversion optimization.

agents.name: Designer/Creator
agents.description: Visual content creator responsible for social media graphics, ad creatives, email templates, presentation decks, brand assets, and multimedia content. Maintains brand visual standards.

agents.name: Marketing GPO
agents.description: Operational support agent handling CRM data management, report generation, asset organization, compliance checks, and administrative marketing tasks.

workflows.name: Campaign Planning Workflow
workflows.description: End-to-end marketing campaign planning process from strategy definition through execution and performance analysis.

config.description: Define campaign objectives, target audience, key messages, success metrics (KPIs), budget allocation, and timeline
Determine optimal channel mix (email, social, search, content, paid ads) based on audience profiles and campaign goals
Develop content calendar and creative brief. Define content types, formats, messaging frameworks, and production schedule
Produce visual assets, ad creatives, email templates, and multimedia content according to brand guidelines
Review all campaign materials for brand compliance, messaging accuracy, and quality. Approve or request revisions
Launch campaign across all channels. Monitor real-time performance metrics and adjust bids, targeting, or creative as needed

workflows.name: Content Creation Workflow
workflows.description: Structured content creation process from topic selection through writing, design, review, and publication with SEO optimization.

config.description: Select topics based on content calendar, SEO keyword research, audience interests, and business priorities. Define target keywords and search intent
Research topic thoroughly, create content outline, identify source materials, and define content structure and key takeaways
Write content draft following brand voice guidelines. Optimize for SEO with target keywords, meta descriptions, and internal linking
Create supporting visuals, featured images, infographics, or charts. Ensure all visuals follow brand guidelines
Review content for accuracy, tone, brand alignment, and SEO optimization. Request revisions if needed
Publish content to CMS, schedule social media promotion, add to email newsletters, and submit to search engines for indexing

workflows.name: Social Media Publishing Workflow
workflows.description: Social media content planning, creation, scheduling, and engagement management across multiple platforms.

config.description: Plan social media content calendar across platforms. Determine posting frequency, content mix (educational, promotional, engaging), and optimal posting times
Design platform-specific visual assets including images, short-form video, stories, and carousel posts
Write platform-optimized captions with relevant hashtags, calls-to-action, and engagement hooks. Include UTM parameters for tracking
Review social media content for brand compliance, messaging accuracy, and engagement potential. Approve scheduled content
Schedule and publish content across all social media platforms using social media management tools
Monitor comments, messages, and mentions. Respond to audience engagement, manage community, and flag urgent issues to the team

workflows.name: Lead Nurturing Workflow
workflows.description: Automated lead nurturing sequences that move prospects through the marketing funnel with targeted content and personalized messaging.

config.description: Classify and segment the lead based on source, industry, company size, behavioral signals, and lead score into appropriate nurturing stream
Activate the appropriate lead nurturing email sequence based on the lead segment. Configure timing, content personalization, and trigger conditions
Deliver personalized content through email, retargeting ads, and in-app messages based on lead engagement and behavioral triggers
Track lead engagement across all touchpoints: email opens, clicks, content downloads, website visits, and content interactions
Update lead score based on engagement. Route high-scoring leads to sales team. Continue nurturing for lower-scoring leads with additional content
Analyze sequence performance: open rates, click-through rates, conversion rates, and drop-off points. Optimize content and timing through A/B testing

workflows.name: Performance Analysis Workflow
workflows.description: Regular performance analysis process to evaluate marketing campaign effectiveness, channel ROI, and identify optimization opportunities.

config.description: Aggregate performance data from all marketing channels: website analytics, ad platforms, email platforms, social media, and CRM
Calculate key performance indicators: CAC, ROI, conversion rates, engagement rates, lead volume, funnel metrics, and channel attribution
Generate performance report with channel breakdown, campaign results, trend analysis, and comparison against targets
Analyze report to identify top-performing channels, underperforming areas, successful tactics, and optimization opportunities
Formulate strategic recommendations: reallocate budget, adjust targeting, modify creative, pause underperforming campaigns, or scale winning approaches
Present performance summary and recommendations to stakeholders. Update marketing dashboard and archive historical data

semantic_memory.description: Stores brand voice guidelines, content performance data, SEO keyword strategies, and audience insights for informed content decisions

episodic_memory.description: Records campaign results, content publication history, engagement patterns, and event outcomes for retrospective analysis

procedural_memory.description: Caches successful campaign templates, email sequences, content workflows, and operational procedures for repeatable marketing processes

graph_memory.description: Not used -- audience segments and channel relationships tracked in marketing automation platform

immutable_storage.description: CMS publication history, email send logs, and campaign records serve as the immutable record of all marketing activities

governance_rules.name: Brand Voice and Visual Standards
governance_rules.description: All marketing content must follow approved brand voice guidelines and visual standards. The Marketing Manager or Designer must review and approve all customer-facing materials before publication.

governance_rules.name: Campaign Approval Process
governance_rules.description: All paid campaigns must have budget approval from the Marketing Manager before launch. Campaign materials must be reviewed for compliance, accuracy, and brand alignment prior to any public release.

governance_rules.name: Data Privacy and Compliance
governance_rules.description: All lead data must be collected and processed in compliance with GDPR, CAN-SPAM, and relevant data protection regulations. Unsubscribe requests must be honored within 24 hours. Personal data must be stored securely and only used for stated purposes.

governance_rules.name: Content SEO Standards
governance_rules.description: All published content must include SEO optimization: target keywords in title, headers, and first paragraph, meta description under 160 characters, alt text for images, and internal links to relevant pages.

governance_rules.name: Social Media Compliance
governance_rules.description: All social media posts must comply with platform policies, industry regulations (especially for regulated industries), and company social media policy. Financial disclosures and sponsored content tags must be included where required.

kpis.name: Lead Generation
kpis.description: Number of qualified marketing leads generated per month Measured as: count per month

thresholds.target_label: based on revenue targets (typically 100-500/month depending on company)

kpis.name: Conversion Rate
kpis.description: Percentage of website visitors who complete a desired action (form fill, demo request, purchase) Measured as: percentage

kpis.name: Customer Acquisition Cost (CAC)
kpis.description: Total marketing spend divided by number of new customers acquired Measured as: currency per customer

kpis.name: Marketing ROI
kpis.description: Revenue attributed to marketing divided by total marketing spend Measured as: ratio

kpis.name: Engagement Rate
kpis.description: Average engagement rate across social media platforms (likes, comments, shares, saves) Measured as: percentage

kpis.name: Brand Awareness
kpis.description: Brand visibility measured by social reach, search volume, direct traffic, and social mentions Measured as: composite score

kpis.name: Content Performance
kpis.description: Content engagement metrics including page views, time on page, social shares, and lead generation from content assets Measured as: composite score

integrations.name: Content Management System (WordPress / Contentful / HubSpot CMS)
integrations.purpose: Content creation, management, and publishing platform with SEO tools, version control, and multi-author collaboration

integrations.name: Social Media Management (Buffer / Hootsuite / Sprout Social)
integrations.purpose: Multi-platform social media scheduling, publishing, engagement management, and performance analytics

integrations.name: Email Marketing (Mailchimp / HubSpot / SendGrid)
integrations.purpose: Email campaign creation, automated nurture sequences, list management, A/B testing, and performance analytics

integrations.name: Analytics (Google Analytics 4 / Mixpanel)
integrations.purpose: Website traffic analysis, conversion tracking, user behavior analysis, and funnel visualization

integrations.name: CRM (Salesforce / HubSpot CRM)
integrations.purpose: Lead management, contact tracking, deal pipeline, campaign attribution, and sales-marketing handoff

integrations.name: Ad Platforms (Google Ads / Meta Ads / LinkedIn Ads)
integrations.purpose: Paid advertising campaign management across search, social, and display channels with real-time bid and budget optimization

operational_policies.name: Brand Approval Policy
operational_policies.description: All customer-facing marketing materials must be reviewed and approved by the Marketing Manager or designated Designer before publication. Emergency content requires post-hoc approval within 4 hours. Brand guideline changes require Marketing Manager approval.

operational_policies.name: Content Calendar Discipline
operational_policies.description: All marketing activities must be planned and tracked in the shared content calendar at least 2 weeks in advance. Emergency content is permitted but should not exceed 10% of total monthly content volume. Content calendar reviews occur weekly on Monday standup.

operational_policies.name: Data Privacy and Consent Management
operational_policies.description: All lead data collection must include clear consent mechanisms. Double opt-in required for email subscriptions. Personal data must be stored in compliance with GDPR/CAN-SPAM. Unsubscribe and data deletion requests must be processed within 24 hours. Quarterly privacy compliance audit required.
